title: Concrete complex of sections of associated module sheaves
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and W an open of Spec R [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Define T_W:ModuleCat R -> ModuleCat R by associating Mathlib tilde M to a module M, forgetting to its sheaf of R-modules with modulesSpecToSheaf, and evaluating at W. It acts on morphisms by evaluation of tilde.map. For a nonnegative cochain complex K, define C_W(K) degreewise by this functor and its mapped differentials. The maps tilde.toOpen give a natural cochain map K -> C_W(K). All objects, maps and differentials are explicit constructions, with no existence choice.

proof.text: Compose the existing tilde, forgetful and evaluation functors. The composite preserves zero maps by tilde.map_zero. Apply mapHomologicalComplex. The components tilde.toOpen commute with differentials by tilde.toOpen_map_app, giving the restriction cochain map.
